# prime-fileupload

prime-rs: FileUpload component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/fileupload) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-fileupload) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/fileupload.md)

FileUpload — port of `p-fileupload` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

File upload: choosing with a button or drag and drop, type, size and count checks, a list with previews and state
icons, a progress indicator and sending to the server via `XMLHttpRequest` or a custom handler.
Checks and labels are pure logic in `files`.

```rust
#![recursion_limit = "512"]
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_fileupload::FileUpload;

let html = view! { <FileUpload name="demo[]" url="/upload" multiple=true accept="image/*" /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-fileupload-advanced") && html.contains("p-fileupload-choose-button"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-fileupload = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["fileupload"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
